94: /** WCAG relative luminance threshold — below this, `data-background-color` drives dark surface tokens. */
95: const AUDIT_BG_LUMA_THRESHOLD = 0.45;
96:
97: const parseColorToRgb = (raw) => {
98:   if (!raw || typeof raw !== "string") return null;
99:   const s = raw.trim();
100:   const hex = s.match(/^#([\da-f]{3}|[\da-f]{6})$/i);
101:   if (hex) {
102:     let h = hex[1];
103:     if (h.length === 3) h = [...h].map((c) => c + c).join("");
104:     const n = parseInt(h, 16);
105:     return { r: (n >> 16) & 255, g: (n >> 8) & 255, b: n & 255 };
106:   }
107:   const rgb = s.match(/^rgba?\(\s*([\d.]+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)/i);
108:   if (rgb) return { r: +rgb[1], g: +rgb[2], b: +rgb[3] };
109:   return null;
110: };
111:
112: const relativeLuminanceRgb = (rgb) => {
113:   if (!rgb) return 1;
114:   const lin = [rgb.r, rgb.g, rgb.b].map((c) => {
115:     c /= 255;
116:     return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
117:   });
118:   return 0.2126 * lin[0] + 0.7152 * lin[1] + 0.0722 * lin[2];
119: };
120:
121: const isDarkBackgroundColorAttr = (raw) =>
122:   relativeLuminanceRgb(parseColorToRgb(raw || "")) < AUDIT_BG_LUMA_THRESHOLD;
123:
124: const resolveAuditSurface = (el) => {
125:   const section = el.closest("section");
126:   const slide = el.closest("audit-slide");
127:   const variant = slide?.getAttribute("variant");
128:   if (variant === "dark") return "dark";
129:   if (variant === "light") return "light";
130:   if (
131:     section &&
132:     isDarkBackgroundColorAttr(section.getAttribute("data-background-color"))
133:   )
134:     return "dark";
135:   return "light";
136: };
137:
138: const syncAuditSurfaceTheme = (el) => {
139:   const section = el.closest("section");
140:   if (!section) return;
141:   section.setAttribute("data-audit-surface", resolveAuditSurface(el));
142: };
143:
144: /** Dark slide typography when `data-audit-surface="dark"` is set on an ancestor section. */
145: const auditSurfaceDarkTokens = `
146:   :host-context([data-audit-surface="dark"]) {
147:     color: var(--color-page-background);
148:     --text: var(--color-page-background);
149:     --text-muted: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 72%, transparent);
150:     --text-light: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 88%, transparent);
151:     --section-number: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 38%, transparent);
152:     --audit-number-emphasis: var(--audit-number-user, var(--color-accent-green));
153:     --audit-divider-on-surface: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 14%, transparent);
154:   }
155: `;

244: class AuditCover extends HTMLElement {

253:     shadow.innerHTML = `
254:       <style>
255:         ${sharedFont}
256:         :host { ${baseTokens} display: block; height: 100%; color: var(--color-page-background); position: relative; }
257:         .bg { position: absolute; inset: 0;
258:           ${bg ? `background-image: url(${bg}); background-size: cover; background-position: center;` : ""}
259:           z-index: 0; }
260:         .overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0;
261:           background: linear-gradient(
262:             180deg,
263:             color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-dark) 50%, transparent) 0%,
264:             color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-dark) 85%, transparent) 70%,
265:             color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-dark) 95%, transparent) 100%);
266:           z-index: 1; }
267:         .content { position: relative; z-index: 2;
268:           padding: var(--audit-slide-padding); color: var(--color-page-background);
269:           display: flex; flex-direction: column;
270:           justify-content: ${bg ? "flex-end" : "center"};
271:           min-height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }
272:         .meta { font: var(--typography-label-caps); text-transform: uppercase;
273:           letter-spacing: 2.5px;
274:           color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 55%, transparent);
275:           margin-bottom: var(--spacing-space-md); }
276:         .logo { height: auto; width: 200px; margin-bottom: var(--spacing-space-xs); }
277:         ::slotted(h1) {
278:           font: var(--typography-audit-cover-title) !important;
279:           color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 88%, transparent) !important;
280:           margin: 0 !important;
281:           letter-spacing: -0.02em !important;
282:           max-width: 880px !important;
283:         }
284:         .nav { position: absolute; bottom: var(--spacing-space-2xl); right: var(--spacing-space-3xl); z-index: 2;
285:           display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
286:           color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 45%, transparent);
287:           font: var(--typography-body-sm);
288:           letter-spacing: 0.5px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s; }
289:         .nav:hover { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 80%, transparent); }
290:         .arrow { width: var(--spacing-space-xl); height: var(--spacing-space-xl); border-radius: 50%;
291:           border: 1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 30%, transparent);
292:           display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
293:         .nav:hover .arrow {
294:           border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 60%, transparent);
295:           background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 8%, transparent); }
296:         .arrow svg { width: var(--spacing-space-md); height: var(--spacing-space-md); fill: none; stroke: currentColor;
297:           stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
298:       </style>
299:       <div class="bg"></div>
300:       <div class="overlay"></div>
301:       <div class="content">
302:         ${meta ? `<div class="meta">${meta}</div>` : ""}
303:         ${logo ? `<img class="logo" src="${logo}" alt="${logoAlt}">` : ""}
304:         <slot></slot>

307:         hasNav

310:           <span>Begin</span>
311:           <div class="arrow"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"></polyline></svg></div>
312:         </div>
313:       `
314:           : ""
315:       }
316:     `;
317:   }
318: }
319: customElements.define("audit-cover", AuditCover);

764:       <div class="body"><slot></slot></div>
765:       ${status ? `<div class="badge">✓ ${status}</div>` : ""}
766:       <slot name="screenshot"></slot>

772: /* ───────── <audit-palette-row> ───────── */
773: class AuditPaletteRow extends HTMLElement {
774:   connectedCallback() {
775:     syncAuditSurfaceTheme(this);
776:     const shadow = this.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
777:     const label = this.getAttribute("label") || "";
778:     // swatches passed as: <audit-palette-row swatches='[{"bg":"hsl(46,97%,49%)","label":"base","light":false}, ...]'>
779:     let swatches = [];
780:     try {
781:       swatches = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute("swatches") || "[]");
782:     } catch {}
783:     shadow.innerHTML = `
784:       <style>
785:         ${sharedFont}
786:         ${auditSurfaceDarkTokens}
787:         :host { ${baseTokens} display: block; margin-bottom: 28px; }
788:         .row-label { font: var(--typography-audit-section-label);
789:           text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px;
790:           color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 10px; }
791:         .row { display: flex; gap: 0; border-radius: 8px; contain:paint }
792:         .sw { flex: 1; height: 80px;
793:           position: relative; display: flex;
794:           align-items: flex-end; padding: 8px 12px; box-sizing: border-box; }
795:         .sw .name { font: var(--typography-audit-palette-swatch-name);
796:           color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 100%, transparent); }
797:         .sw.light .name { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 100%, transparent); }
798:       </style>
799:       ${label ? `<div class="row-label">${label}</div>` : ""}
800:       <div class="row">
801:         ${swatches
802:           .map(
803:             (s) => `
804:           <div class="sw ${s.light ? "light" : ""}" style="background:${s.bg}">
805:             <span class="name">${s.label}</span>
806:           </div>
807:         `,
808:           )
809:           .join("")}
810:       </div>
811:     `;
812:   }
813: }
814: customElements.define("audit-palette-row", AuditPaletteRow);

847:           color: var(--color-neutral-900); }
848:         .status-attention {
849:           background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-purple) 28%, var(--color-page-background));
850:           color: var(--color-dark-purple); }

853:         .detail { font: var(--typography-audit-principle-detail); color: var(--color-alt-text); }
854:       </style>
855:       <div class="status status-${status}">${statusLabels[status]}</div>
856:       <div class="name">${name}</div>
857:       <div class="detail"><slot></slot></div>

921: /* ───────── helpers for plain slide layouts ───────── */
922: /**
923:  * <audit-slide variant="light|dark|auto"> wraps slide content with inset padding.
924:  * Omit variant or use auto: theme follows the section's data-background-color (luminance);
925:  * slide background stays transparent so Reveal's section color shows through.
926:  * variant="dark": solid --dark panel plus dark typography.
927:  * variant="light": force light tokens even on a dark section (rare).
928:  */
929: class AuditSlide extends HTMLElement {
930:   connectedCallback() {
931:     syncAuditSurfaceTheme(this);
932:     const variant = this.getAttribute("variant");
933:     const centered = this.hasAttribute("centered");
934:     const section = this.closest("section");
935:     const solidDarkPanel = variant === "dark";
936:     const darkTypography =
937:       solidDarkPanel ||
938:       (variant !== "light" &&
939:         section &&
940:         isDarkBackgroundColorAttr(
941:           section.getAttribute("data-background-color"),
942:         ));
943:
944:     if (darkTypography) this.setAttribute("data-audit-dark-heading", "");
945:     else {
946:       this.removeAttribute("data-audit-dark-heading");
947:       this.style.removeProperty("--audit-slide-heading-computed");
948:     }
949:
950:     const shadow = this.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
951:     shadow.innerHTML = `
952:       <style>
953:         ${sharedFont}
954:         ${auditSurfaceDarkTokens}
955:         :host { ${baseTokens} display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0;
956:           height: 100%;
957:           padding: var(--audit-slide-padding); box-sizing: border-box;
958:           ${solidDarkPanel ? "background: var(--dark); color: var(--color-page-background);" : ""}
959:           ${centered ? "justify-content: center;" : ""}
960:         }
961:         ::slotted(audit-browser) {
962:           flex: 1 1 auto !important;
963:           min-height: 0 !important;
964:           width: 100% !important;
965:           max-width: 100% !important;
966:           align-self: stretch !important;
967:         }
968:         ::slotted(.audit-slide-label) {
969:           font: var(--typography-audit-section-label) !important;
970:           text-transform: uppercase !important;
971:           letter-spacing: 2.5px !important;
972:           margin-bottom: 16px !important;
973:           display: block !important;
974:           flex-shrink: 0 !important;
975:           color: ${
976:             darkTypography
977:               ? "color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-page-background) 55%, transparent)"
978:               : "var(--text-muted)"
979:           } !important;
980:         }
981:         ::slotted(h2) {
982:           font: var(--typography-audit-slide-heading) !important;
983:           margin: 0 0 16px !important;
984:           letter-spacing: -0.02em !important;
985:         }
986:         :host([data-audit-dark-heading]) ::slotted(h2) {
987:           color: var(--audit-slide-heading-computed, var(--color-accent-green)) !important;
988:         }
989:         :host(:not([data-audit-dark-heading])) ::slotted(h2) {
990:           color: var(--text) !important;
991:         }
992:         ::slotted(p) {
993:           font: var(--typography-audit-slide-body) !important;
994:           color: ${darkTypography ? "var(--text-light)" : "var(--text-muted)"} !important;
995:           max-width: 680px !important;
996:           margin: 0 0 16px !important;
997:         }
998:         ::slotted([slot="grid"]) {
999:           display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0; margin-top: 16px;
1000:         }
1001:         ::slotted([slot="principles"]) {
1002:           display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
1003:           gap: 12px; margin-top: 16px;
1004:         }
1005:       </style>
1006:       <slot name="label-content"></slot>
1007:       <slot></slot>
1008:       <slot name="grid"></slot>
1009:       <slot name="principles"></slot>
1010:       <slot name="footer"></slot>
1011:     `;
1012:
1013:     if (darkTypography) {
1014:       queueMicrotask(() => this.#computeDarkHeadingColor());
1015:     }
1016:
1017:     const label = this.getAttribute("label");
1018:     if (label) {
1019:       const labelEl = document.createElement("div");
1020:       labelEl.setAttribute("slot", "label-content");
1021:       labelEl.className = "audit-slide-label";
1022:       labelEl.textContent = label;
1023:       this.prepend(labelEl);
1024:     }
1025:   }
1026:
